purpose: Prove that the audit left no orphan processes, no listening sockets, no daemons, and no host mutation, per master specification section 29.

isolation_model.statement: Every execution of Ruflo code during this audit ran inside a `docker run --rm` container.
isolation_model.consequence: Ruflo had no write path to host global configuration, credentials, or the user's repositories at any time.

final_census.note: An initial `ps | grep -c` returned 4, which was grep matching audit PATHS in unrelated command lines (e.g. /tmp/aud-ruflo-20260811/...). The itemised `ps -eo pid,command | grep -E 'ruflo|claude-flow' | grep -v grep` returned zero rows. Zero is the verified answer.

ruflo_init.processes_after_completion: only the invoking shell and `ps` itself
ruflo_init.listening_sockets: none (read of /proc/net/tcp and tcp6 showed no state 0A)
ruflo_init.label: VERIFIED

ruflo_cleanup.observed: cleanup — including the documented DRY RUN — starts a background daemon and never stops it; after `cleanup --force` the daemon was still running (cli.js daemon start --foreground --quiet --workspace /repo, PPID 1)
ruflo_cleanup.audit_containment: the daemon died with its disposable container; on a real machine it would persist
ruflo_cleanup.label: VERIFIED

daemon_autostart.observed: a daemon autostarts on ordinary non-daemon commands, including `memory` subcommands, with a 12-hour TTL
daemon_autostart.label: VERIFIED

concurrent_session_observed.what: A separate Claude Code session was writing and then committed docs/audits/hermes-honcho/** into ~/src/tailered-ai during this audit.
concurrent_session_observed.effect_on_this_audit: none — paths are disjoint (docs/audits/ruflo/** vs docs/audits/hermes-honcho/**), verified with an explicit path-overlap check that returned empty
concurrent_session_observed.action_taken: none; their files were never read, modified, staged, or cleaned

head_movement.clarification: main did NOT advance. The concurrent session created its own sibling branch audit/hermes-honcho off the same base and checked it out in the shared working directory, which is why that directory's HEAD moved. An earlier reading of `git rev-parse HEAD` alone suggested the baseline had advanced; reading `main` and `origin/main` directly showed it had not. Both audit branches are siblings off 6172653e with disjoint paths.
head_movement.handling: The audit baseline stayed frozen at 6172653e by design. The audit branch is based on 6172653e, which still equals main and origin/main, so no rebase is required.
